Job highlights
Graduate in any discipline with good SQL and Excel
Build Tableau dashboards and weekly MIS reports for category and supply chain teams

Job description


Saffronleaf is a fast-growing D2C brand selling staples, spices and snacks across 9 states through our app and 1,400+ partner kirana stores. Our Analytics team (6 people) supports the category, supply chain and marketing teams with reports, dashboards and quick analysis.

Roles and Responsibilities
- Build and maintain dashboards in Tableau for category and supply chain teams
- Write SQL queries to pull sales, inventory and order data from our data warehouse
- Clean and prepare data using Excel and Python (pandas) before weekly reviews
- Prepare weekly MIS reports and share key insights with business stakeholders
- Track KPIs like fill rate, sell-through and repeat purchase rate
- Handle ad-hoc analysis requests from category managers
- Document data definitions so that numbers match across teams


Desired Candidate Profile

Must have:
* Graduate in any discipline (B.Com / BBA / B.Sc / BCA / B.Tech)
* Good knowledge of SQL - joins, GROUP BY, subqueries
* Advanced Excel - pivot tables, VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP, charts
* Hands-on Tableau (please share at least one dashboard link)
* Basic Python for data cleaning (pandas)
* Good communication in English and Hindi

Good to have:
* Power BI
* Knowledge of retail / FMCG metrics
* Basic statistics


Perks and benefits
Health insurance, Performance bonus, Laptop provided, 5 days working, Monthly team outings

expectations.trap_notes: Power BI is not Tableau: don't swap them or write 'Tableau/Power BI'. All analytics projects are coursework or self-study on public datasets, not client or employer work, so don't present them as professional experience. The internship was 3 months of accounts/MIS work; don't retitle it 'Data Analyst Intern'. 'Advanced Excel' is supported only through pivot tables, VLOOKUP and pivot charts (XLOOKUP isn't evidenced). No retail/FMCG KPI work (fill rate, sell-through) in the profile. Keep CGPA 7.6/10 as stated.
